review.method: Visually inspected extracted frames at 0, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10 and 11.9 seconds against the combined image and verified first-choice plan. Sampled-frame review, not continuous audiovisual playback.
review.first_frame_layout: Closely preserves the supplied arena, +3 Knights/+5 Geese options, tutorial hand, Player54399/WIZARD headers, three hearts each and 1/3 indicator. No pixel-exact equivalence is claimed.
review.input_causality: The hand taps the right +5 Geese card. The knights option disappears; the chosen card lifts to center, dissolves, and geese arrive with blue trails and landing rings. No unchosen knights are deployed.
review.counts_and_character_identity: Exactly five distinct geese are visible at 7, 8, 10 and 11.9 seconds; three are visible during the earlier staged arrival at 6 seconds. Their white/lavender bodies, dark outlines and orange beaks/feet match the card identity. No extra goose, character swap or battle is visible in sampled frames. Exact per-frame arrival continuity was not established.
review.ui_and_camera: The zoom around 4–8 seconds crops player headers, outer hearts and the lower 1/3/control area, violating the plan to retain headers/hearts. Full reference framing returns by 10 seconds, with three hearts per side and 1/3 unchanged. Choose a card! remains above the deployed group. No new offer, reward, heart loss or victory screen appears.
review.vfx_readability: Card lift/dissolve, distinct blue arrival trails and landing rings make the selection/deployment legible. Some trails pass over the choice banner, but the settled five-unit count is clear and effects have cleared at the end.

audio.note: Audio stream presence verified only; voiceover wording, mix and synchronization were not assessed.

limitations: Sampled frames cannot certify every transient count or motion artifact.
The enlarged central group is a presentation concept, not verification of original battlefield formation or unit scale.
